# Surfdesk

> Surfdesk is an everyday organizer for professionals, entrepreneurs and busy people. Tasks and to-dos, notes, lists, reminders, calendar and voice capture live in one place, alongside clients and customers, visits, follow-ups, bookings and reports. Type it or say it once and Surfdesk files it, reminds you and keeps it together. Made by Sonder Project.

Surfdesk runs in the browser on any phone or computer and can be added to the home screen like an app. It works for individuals and for teams: freelancers, coaches, consultants, contractors, salons, gyms, clinics, agencies and nonprofits.

## Product

- [Home](https://thesurfdesk.app/): What Surfdesk does, plans and pricing
- [Create an account](https://thesurfdesk.app/signup): Start a free trial

## Pricing

- Individual: $9 a month after a 7-day free trial, no card needed to start.
- Organization (teams of 2 or more, includes team chat with channels and direct messages): a 14-day free trial, then $19 a seat a month for 2 to 18 seats, $349 a month for 19 to 20 seats, and $15 for each seat over 20.

## Who it's for

- [Small businesses](https://thesurfdesk.app/for/small-business): Customer history, reminders to reach out and revenue by service
- [Coaches and consultants](https://thesurfdesk.app/for/coaches): Session notes, next steps and revenue by client
- [Realtors](https://thesurfdesk.app/for/realtors): Contacts, follow-ups and voice notes between showings
- [Case managers](https://thesurfdesk.app/for/case-managers): Voice notes, a Today list and full client history
- [Nonprofits](https://thesurfdesk.app/for/nonprofits): Shared client list, check-ins and one-click impact reports
